author: James Clear
core_principle: An imperfect 2-minute version beats a skipped 60-minute session. Redefine victory from execution perfection to maintaining identity.
coaching_directive: Reframe the session. Strip away all performance expectations and direct the user to complete only the micro-floor version today.

author: James Clear
core_principle: Scale the habit down so it takes two minutes or less to perform, reducing activation resistance during physiological fatigue.
coaching_directive: Acknowledge depleted capacity without judgment. Radically scale down the target to protect the habit baseline.

author: BJ Fogg
core_principle: Attach the target behavior immediately after a stable, automatic daily anchor (e.g., 'After I sit down with my morning coffee, I will...').
coaching_directive: Help the user identify an existing daily anchor routine and bind this habit directly behind it.

author: Charles Duhigg
core_principle: Pair a behavior you need to do with an immediate sensory reward you enjoy to close the neurological dopamine loop.
coaching_directive: Instruct the user to pair this specific task with an immediate guilty-pleasure reward during execution.
